title: littlehole2025/token-saver — 長對話 Token 提醒與 Session Handoff
resourceType: Claude Code plugin / long conversation token-usage reminder + desktop-only handoff skill
purpose: 透過 Claude Code UserPromptSubmit Hook 讀取 Transcript 最近一筆包含 usage 的 Assistant Message，估算 Token 數；達到設定門檻後提示使用者結束當前任務並開新 Session，以交接摘要減少長對話持續堆積的上下文。內附 Handoff Skill 可在有 Session 管理工具的 Claude 桌面版 Code 分頁中開新對話並封存舊對話。
recommendation: 適合長時間使用 Claude Code、希望在對話上下文增加時收到提醒，並在切換 Session 時保留已完成事項、待辦、規則與 Commit 資訊的使用者。先確認是否已使用自動 Compact、Claude-Mem、Handoff Skills 或同類 Hooks；提醒門檻應參考目前 Host/Model 的有效 Context、使用量、快取計費與工作型態，不宜把 150K 當成最佳值。對於涉及封存、改名及開新 Session 的操作，應先確認執行環境有相應工具、目前工作可安全中斷、交接摘要不洩漏秘密，且新對話建立成功後才封存。
version: 1.0.0 (from .claude-plugin/plugin.json; initial release, not independent stability certification)

mechanism.reminder: UserPromptSubmit Hook uses node and transcript_path to read the last up to 2 MB of the transcript; parses the last assistant usage it finds, summing input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens. Outputs both systemMessage and hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext when at threshold.
mechanism.deduplication: Stores the last announced threshold level in a per-session temporary file under the OS tmp directory, avoiding repeat notification for the same bucket.
mechanism.trigger: Reminders happen when the user submits a prompt; not a background monitor, not a guaranteed warning at the precise point the model window fills.
mechanism.handoff: Skill instructions recognize just 換／開新／new／handoff; in Claude desktop Code tab use get_session(self), start_session(context=fresh with incremented title and standalone brief), confirm creation, then archive_session(self). If these actions are missing, provide a handoff summary for manual paste instead.
mechanism.hostLimits: Automatic session creation and archival are documented only for Claude desktop Code tab; terminal CLI receives token warning but needs manual Session switch.

verificationNotes.observedSource: Official README.md, hooks/hooks.json, hooks/long-chat-reminder.js, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, marketplace.json, skills/handoff/SKILL.md, LICENSE, GitHub repository metadata.
behaviorCaveats: The hook-derived token number is an approximation based on the latest observed message usage, not an authoritative current effective context window size, remaining budget or billing forecast.
It cannot guarantee fewer paid tokens, lower end-to-end cost, quality improvements, or fewer errors; no benchmark was located in the reviewed repo.
New-session creation and archival depend on nonstandard host session-management capabilities; presence of the Skill alone does not confer access.
The hook records session threshold state in temp and reads the transcript on each submitted prompt; source and host compatibility should be reviewed before installation.
Hook can add context/instructions on trigger. It does not provide independent memory retrieval, general token compression, or dynamic tool pruning.
Automatically archiving the current session after the new session succeeds is a state-changing action; review the handoff and verify persistence and restore path before relying on it.

securityAndOperations.permissions: Node.js command is registered as Claude Code UserPromptSubmit Hook, reads local transcript file path supplied by host and writes a small per-session threshold marker to OS temporary storage.
securityAndOperations.sessionMutation: Skill invokes desktop session-management tools to create/rename-related sessions and archive current session; this does not run automatically from the Hook without user-triggered Handoff intent.
securityAndOperations.contextPrivacy: Handoff brief may contain project decisions, file paths, task state or other sensitive information; review and omit secrets before copying into a new Session.
securityAndOperations.runtimeCompatibility: Requires Node.js and Claude Code plugin/hook support. Automatic desktop Handoff additionally requires get_session, start_session and archive_session; README does not establish availability in other Clients.
securityAndOperations.isolation: Installation, Hook execution and desktop session management were not performed during cataloging; actual current-host functionality and security were not independently validated.

relationship: 與 microsoft/TokenEconomizer（跨 Session 學習、移除閒置工具與失敗迴圈介入）不同；與 Claude-Mem（保存／檢索長期工作記憶）不同；與 mattpocock /handoff 類似但其 Handoff Skill 明確要求桌面 Session 工具進行建立／封存，並結合長對話 Token Reminder。各工具可能共存，但 Hook／Handoff 命名及操作需確認不衝突。

source.type: Official upstream repository README, hook JavaScript, plugin manifests, standalone SKILL.md and MIT LICENSE
source.summary: Source inspected read-only. Claims of saved tokens, compatibility or successful automatic handoff not validated by installing or running.

notes: 2026-11-01 查核：GitHub 專案成立於 2026-10-31，官方描述與程式碼吻合主要提醒邏輯。Hook 以最近一次 assistant usage 的 input + cache_read_input + cache_creation_input 估算，數字不能直接視為模型精確上下文長度或實際成本。預設門檻 150K、遞增 50K，只有使用者送新訊息時執行；每個門檻級距使用 OS 暫存狀態避免重複提醒。一鍵開新與封存依賴 Claude Desktop Code 專有 Session 工具，不適用一般 Terminal CLI。技術上可和 Claude 自動 Context Compact 同時存在，但成效、衝突及計費變化未實測。此收錄不授權外部 Hook 安裝或執行。
